name: vscode-mcp-extension
description: VS Code extension that exposes terminals via MCP protocol

commands.title: Show VS Code MCP Status / Connect

vscode-mcp.host.description: Host address for the hub server

vscode-mcp.port.description: Port for the hub server (when this instance acts as hub)

vscode-mcp.showStatus.description: Show connection status in the status bar

vscode-mcp.mode.description: auto: probe server, use client mode if reachable else serverless. client-only: always require the central server.

vscode-mcp.terminalEngine.description: auto: use shell integration if available, else node-pty fallback. force-fallback: always use node-pty.

vscode-mcp.outputBufferLines.description: Max lines of terminal output to buffer per terminal

vscode-mcp.satelliteTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for waiting on a satellite (remote VS Code window) to respond to a tool call. Default matches terminalRunTimeoutMs (300000 = 5 min). Hub also uses max(this, timeout_ms) for terminal_run/terminal_wait.

vscode-mcp.terminalRunTimeoutMs.description: Default hard wait (ms) for terminal_run when timeout_ms is omitted. On expiry the command keeps running and the tool returns [STILL RUNNING]; call terminal_wait to continue. Default 300000 (5 min).

vscode-mcp.terminalWaitTimeoutMs.description: Default max block (ms) for terminal_wait when timeout_ms is omitted. On expiry returns [STILL RUNNING]; call again or abort with terminal_send_text. Default 300000 (5 min).

vscode-mcp.shellReadDrainMs.description: After shell-integration end event, max ms to wait for execution.read() to finish draining output before returning. Remote SSH often ends the command while read() stays open; without this drain, terminal_run hangs until timeout_ms. Default 500.

vscode-mcp.shellStartBindMs.description: Max ms to wait for onDidStartTerminalShellExecution after executeCommand so we can rebind to the event execution object (required on remote SSH where returned execution !== event execution). Default 5000.

vscode-mcp.terminalCreateWarmupMs.description: After terminal_create, wait this long (ms) before returning so shell integration is ready for the first command on remote SSH. Default 5000.
